visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Queue Is Filled with push
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The queue should hand out 1 first and then 2, but the program prints 3 2.

solution.explanation: push inserts at the front of a Deque, while poll takes from the front, so the newest element comes out first, which is stack behaviour. A queue adds at the back (offer or add) and polls from the front.
